# M1K3 for Mac

> M1K3 is free, open-source (Apache-2.0), privacy-first AI for
> macOS that runs entirely on-device. Local LLM inference (Gemma + Qwen via
> MLX-Swift + Apple Foundation Models), live voice (streaming STT + on-device
> Kokoro neural TTS), a personal knowledge graph with RAG over your documents,
> a self-repairing temporal memory graph, consent-gated encrypted call
> transcription, a local tool-using agent, and an MCP server. Zero bytes of
> user data leave the Mac. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 Tahoe. Native
> SwiftUI (Liquid Glass), not Electron. Made by Round Tower, Ireland.

Key facts:
- Privacy: all inference, embeddings, voice, and storage are on-device; the
  optional web-search tool is off by default; even per-answer thumbs feedback
  stays local and is never writable over MCP
- Models: three brains — Mini (Apple Foundation Models, instant), Lil (Qwen 3
  4B, the fast brain that fronts the conversation), Big (Gemma 4 12B, reached
  by delegation for deep work) — MLX-Swift on Metal, switchable in Settings
- Voice: Kokoro neural TTS on-device (pure MLX) with M1K3's own G2P
  letter-to-sound + house lexicon, sentence-streamed speech, and M1K3's own
  end-of-turn endpointing — ending a spoken turn on "please" submits it
- Storage: app-sandboxed, GRDB, encrypted with a Keychain-held key
- Memory: a temporal memory graph with dream-cycle self-repair — corrections
  supersede stale facts instead of silently losing them, with a visible history
- Heartbeat: an ambient 2-hourly narrative pulse about your machine and day —
  quiet hours respected, off by default, never enters the chat transcript
- Brain at Home: serve the Mac's brain to your own devices over the LAN —
  Bonjour discovery, one-time QR pairing, TLS-PSK, scoped read-only tools for
  paired devices; off by default, nothing crosses the internet
- Screensaver: a native macOS screensaver (the pixel M in ambient rain),
  installable from Settings
- MCP server: 16 tools (knowledge search, documents, voice, memory, ask —
  with an async job API for long asks) over local HTTP at
  http://127.0.0.1:4242/mcp
- Install: signed & notarized DMG at
  https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3/releases/latest/download/M1K3.dmg,
  TestFlight beta, or build from source
- License/source: Apache-2.0, https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3

## Docs

- [Repository and build-from-source](https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3): monorepo; the Mac app lives in macos/
- [macOS app roadmap](https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3/blob/master/macos/ROADMAP.md): what's next (PLAN.md in the same folder is the historical decision record)

## Answers

- [M1K3 vs Ollama](https://m1k3.app/vs-ollama): Ollama is a model server you build on; M1K3 is a finished on-device AI app — fair comparison table
- [Private ChatGPT alternative for Mac](https://m1k3.app/private-chatgpt-alternative-mac): privacy by architecture vs by policy; M1K3 vs Ollama vs LM Studio vs the ChatGPT desktop app
- [How to run a local LLM on a Mac](https://m1k3.app/local-llm-mac-guide): hardware needs plus the four routes — Ollama, LM Studio, MLX, M1K3
- [Give Claude a local memory with MCP](https://m1k3.app/mcp-knowledge-server): connect Claude Code/Desktop to M1K3's knowledge at http://127.0.0.1:4242/mcp
- [Is M1K3 really private?](https://m1k3.app/privacy): the privacy architecture — what runs on-device, the three documented network crossings (opt-in model downloads, off-by-default web search, updates), and how to verify

## Optional

- [Launch site](https://m1k3.app/): product overview and FAQ
- [Meet the companions](https://m1k3.app/companions): the opt-in 3D voice-mode creatures — Fox, Inkfish, Sparrow, Gecko, Colobus — rendered on-device with RealityKit
- [Round Tower](https://round-tower.ie): the company behind M1K3
